title: Reduced algebraic space
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $X$ an algebraic space over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space]. The algebraic space $X$ is reduced if for every scheme $T$ over $S$ and every representable etale map $h_T \to X$, the scheme $T$ is reduced [def-pc-reduced-scheme], equivalently all its local rings have no nonzero nilpotents.
